attempts.summary: Set up HTTPS on node1 port 8443 via nginx, serving a certificate issued by a local CA. A systemd timer (cert-renew.timer, checking every 20s) renews the short-lived leaf cert automatically before expiry and reloads nginx gracefully so the service keeps answering requests through rotation. Verified a live automatic rotation (serial 02->03) with zero request failures during the transition via a concurrent polling loop. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed its boot id changed, and verified nginx, the renewal timer, the local CA, and cert rotation all recovered post-restart (a forced renewal afterwards succeeded, serial 03->04, with continued 200 OK responses).
